graph.name: Cognizant Evolutionary AI Framework Architecture
graph.notes: Architecture illustrating Cognizant's Evolved Neural Networks (ENN) platform running microservices on Kubernetes via AWS cops, interacting with a customer's AWS environment containing an experiment host, job queue, and ML worker cluster.

nodes.name: ECR
nodes.notes: Stores container images for the microservices running the ENN Service.

nodes.name: ENN SERVICE
nodes.notes: Evolved Neural Networks service running microservices auto-scaled via Kubernetes (cops on AWS).

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Stores internal representations of candidate neural network architectures across evolutionary generations.

nodes.name: EXP HOST
nodes.notes: Customer experiment host that orchestrates evaluations, provides domain/config code, and aggregates results.

nodes.name: SQS
nodes.notes: Queue holding evaluation tasks for candidate network architectures.

nodes.name: STUDIO ML WORKERS
nodes.notes: Cluster of worker nodes evaluating candidate neural network architectures.

nodes.name: DOMAIN DATA
nodes.notes: Customer training and domain data used by Studio ML Workers during candidate evaluation.

edges.notes: ECR supplies microservice container images to ENN Service.
ENN Service persists internal representations of neural network architectures to S3.
Experiment Host requests new candidate network architectures from ENN Service.
ENN Service returns generated candidate network graph specifications to Experiment Host.
Experiment Host pushes evaluation jobs into SQS queue.
Studio ML workers pull evaluation tasks from SQS queue.
Studio ML workers fetch customer domain training data from S3.
